rules.reason_if_failed: You must be born before 22 September 1959 to be eligible for Winter Fuel Payment

rules.description: Must live in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: Winter Fuel Payment is only available to residents of England and Wales. Scotland and Northern Ireland have separate schemes.

rules.description: Must not have been in hospital for free treatment for whole of qualifying week (15-21 Sept 2025) and the year before
rules.reason_if_failed: You are not eligible if you were in hospital receiving free in-patient treatment for the entire qualifying week and the year before

rules.description: Must not have been in prison for whole qualifying week (15-21 Sept 2025)
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Winter Fuel Payment if you were in prison for the whole of the qualifying week

rules.description: Must not have 'no public funds' restriction on immigration status
rules.reason_if_failed: You are not eligible if your granted leave to enter the UK says you cannot claim public funds

rules.description: From 2024/25, must receive Pension Credit or another qualifying means-tested benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: From winter 2024/25, Winter Fuel Payment is only available if you receive Pension Credit or another qualifying benefit. You may be eligible for Pension Credit - check now.

edge_cases.description: Lives in care home and receives qualifying benefits from 23 June 2025 or earlier
edge_cases.action: Not eligible for Winter Fuel Payment. Reduced payment of £100-£150 may apply in some circumstances. Route to manual assessment.
Payment will be made but HMRC will recover it through tax code or Self Assessment. Inform citizen that HMRC will take it back.

edge_cases.description: Lives with partner and both claim qualifying benefits jointly
edge_cases.action: One person will receive a single payment. Amount depends on ages. Route to household assessment.

edge_cases.description: Has deferred State Pension since last Winter Fuel Payment
edge_cases.action: Must make a manual claim. Route to claim process.

edge_cases.description: Never received Winter Fuel Payment before and does not receive automatic qualifying benefits
edge_cases.action: Must make a manual claim by phone or post. Deadline 31 March 2026.
